tools.name: summer_github_issues_read
tools.description: Check issue permission and repository visibility, or read one original GitHub issue by number. Restricted to company-selected repositories; no credentials or writes. Issue closure does not resolve the customer case.

tools.name: summer_github_connection_read
tools.description: Read the company GitHub installation, selected repositories/folders and cached commit status. Makes no GitHub request and returns no credentials.

tools.name: summer_github_repositories_list

tools.name: summer_github_folders_list

tools.name: summer_github_sources_save
tools.description: Choose repository branches/commits and allowed folders. A dot selects the whole repository. Replaces selections with an expected version and invalidates old cached access. Does not sync code.

tools.name: summer_github_sources_sync
tools.description: Refresh the selected repository code cache once from GitHub. Reuses the cache for an unchanged commit; sandbox startup never pulls GitHub.

tools.name: summer_github_sources_read
tools.description: List cached source paths, or read one cached file with path. Only currently selected company folders are available. No live GitHub call or credentials.

tools.name: summer_github_connection_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect this company/environment GitHub source access and remove its cached archives.

tools.name: summer_reports_themes_list

tools.name: summer_reports_themes_generate

tools.name: summer_reports_themes_review

tools.name: summer_workflows_list

tools.name: summer_workflows_history

tools.name: summer_workflows_save

tools.name: summer_workflows_request_text

tools.name: summer_support_policy_update

tools.name: summer_saved_replies_history

tools.name: summer_saved_views_delete

tools.name: summer_quality_scenarios_save

tools.name: summer_quality_assessments_save

tools.name: summer_reports_commitments
tools.description: Read outstanding customer promises and unfinished work.

tools.name: summer_agent_exclusions_list
tools.description: Read the company's sender exclusions and original edit history. Changes retain human approval.

tools.name: summer_messenger_conversations_list

tools.description: Read recent scheduled runs with original definition revisions, outcomes, coverage, saved source counts and failures.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "summer_reports_samples_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read paginated original issue/message references behind service counts and timing samples, with date/channel/hour filters in the company timezone. No messages are sent or marked read." → after: "Read paginated original issue/message references behind service counts and timing samples, with date/channel/hour filters in the company timezone. Read-only Intercom archive projections are excluded from operational workload counts. No messages are sent or marked read."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
